title: The order the optimiser chooses, and the order written
data: o: the orders, 50 times over; c and n: the customers and the countries.

cases.label: The optimiser's order
cases.detail: SELECT count(*), max(c.name), max(n.name) FROM o JOIN c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN n ON c.country = n.country WHERE n.region = 'Asia'

cases.label: As written
cases.detail: SET disabled_optimizers = 'join_order'; SELECT count(*), max(c.name), max(n.name) FROM o JOIN c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN n ON c.country = n.country WHERE n.region = 'Asia'
